chinese: 添加 2 辆车进行对比

kinyarwanda: Fungura itangazo urikande kuri «Gereranya» kugira ngo ribe hano. Ushobora gereranya imodoka 3.
swahili: Fungua tangazo lolote na ubonyeze "Linganisha" ili liongezwe hapa. Hadi magari 3 kwa pamoja.
french: Ouvrez une annonce et touchez « Comparer » pour l’ajouter ici. Jusqu’à 3 voitures côte à côte.
korean: 게시물을 열고 "비교"를 눌러 추가하세요. 최대 3대까지 나란히 비교합니다.
chinese: 打开任意车辆并点击“对比”即可添加到此处，最多可并排对比 3 辆。

english: Price and mileage side by side
french: Prix et kilométrage côte à côte

english: Whether the seller’s ID was verified
french: Si l’identité du vendeur est vérifiée

english: Green highlight = best value in this category
swahili: Kijani = thamani bora katika kundi hili
french: Surlignage vert = meilleure valeur de la catégorie

chinese: 绿色高亮 = 该项最优

french: Ajoutez d’abord un numéro de téléphone.

chinese: 请先添加 WhatsApp 号码。

english: Choose exactly which details signed-in buyers can request from a live listing. Turning visibility off hides that channel immediately.
kinyarwanda: Hitamo neza amakuru abaguzi binjiye bashobora gusaba ku itangazo riri hanze. Kuzimya bihisha iyo nzira ako kanya.
swahili: Chagua hasa maelezo ambayo wanunuzi walioingia wanaweza kuomba kwenye tangazo lililo hewani. Kuzima kunaficha njia hiyo mara moja.
french: Choisissez précisément les coordonnées que les acheteurs connectés peuvent demander sur une annonce en ligne. Désactiver un canal le masque immédiatement.
korean: 게시 중인 차량에서 로그인한 구매자가 요청할 수 있는 정보를 직접 선택하세요. 끄면 해당 채널은 즉시 숨겨집니다.
chinese: 选择已登录的买家可从在线车辆中请求哪些联系方式。关闭后该渠道立即隐藏。

english: Enter a valid phone number including the country code.
kinyarwanda: Andika nimero ya telefoni yemewe harimo kode y’igihugu.
swahili: Weka namba halali ya simu pamoja na msimbo wa nchi.
french: Saisissez un numéro de téléphone valide avec l’indicatif du pays.
korean: 국가 번호를 포함한 올바른 전화번호를 입력하세요.
chinese: 请输入包含国家区号的有效电话号码。

english: Enter a valid WhatsApp number including the country code.
kinyarwanda: Andika nimero ya WhatsApp yemewe harimo kode y’igihugu.
swahili: Weka namba halali ya WhatsApp pamoja na msimbo wa nchi.
french: Saisissez un numéro WhatsApp valide avec l’indicatif du pays.
korean: 국가 번호를 포함한 올바른 WhatsApp 번호를 입력하세요.
chinese: 请输入包含国家区号的有效 WhatsApp 号码。

english: Contact disclosure unlocks after the team approves your identity. An administrator can also add these details for you.
kinyarwanda: Gutanga amakuru yo kukuvugisha bifungurwa nyuma y’uko itsinda ryemeje indangamuntu yawe. Umuyobozi ashobora no kubigushyiriraho.
swahili: Kushiriki mawasiliano kunafunguliwa baada ya timu kuidhinisha utambulisho wako. Msimamizi pia anaweza kuongeza maelezo haya kwa niaba yako.
french: Le partage de vos coordonnées se débloque après validation de votre identité par l’équipe. Un administrateur peut aussi les renseigner pour vous.
korean: 팀이 신원을 승인하면 연락처 공개가 활성화됩니다. 관리자가 대신 입력할 수도 있습니다.
chinese: 团队批准您的身份后即可开放联系方式，管理员也可以代为添加。

english: Contact disclosure unlocks after the team approves your identity and business. An administrator can also add these details for you.
kinyarwanda: Gutanga amakuru yo kukuvugisha bifungurwa nyuma y’uko itsinda ryemeje indangamuntu n’ubucuruzi bwawe. Umuyobozi ashobora no kubigushyiriraho.
swahili: Kushiriki mawasiliano kunafunguliwa baada ya timu kuidhinisha utambulisho na biashara yako. Msimamizi pia anaweza kuongeza maelezo haya kwa niaba yako.
french: Le partage de vos coordonnées se débloque après validation de votre identité et de votre entreprise. Un administrateur peut aussi les renseigner pour vous.
korean: 팀이 신원과 사업자를 승인하면 연락처 공개가 활성화됩니다. 관리자가 대신 입력할 수도 있습니다.
chinese: 团队批准您的身份和企业资质后即可开放联系方式，管理员也可以代为添加。

english: Signed-in buyers can request this phone number.
kinyarwanda: Abaguzi binjiye bashobora gusaba iyi nimero ya telefoni.
swahili: Wanunuzi walioingia wanaweza kuomba namba hii ya simu.
french: Les acheteurs connectés peuvent demander ce numéro de téléphone.
korean: 로그인한 구매자가 이 전화번호를 요청할 수 있습니다.
chinese: 已登录的买家可以请求此电话号码。

english: Every disclosure is authenticated and logged. Buyers still accept the direct-deal notice before your contact is returned.
kinyarwanda: Buri gutanga amakuru birasuzumwa kandi bikandikwa. Abaguzi baracyemera itangazo ry’ubufatanye butaziguye mbere yo guhabwa amakuru yawe.
swahili: Kila ufichuzi unathibitishwa na kurekodiwa. Wanunuzi bado wanakubali taarifa ya makubaliano ya moja kwa moja kabla ya kupewa mawasiliano yako.
french: Chaque divulgation est authentifiée et journalisée. Les acheteurs acceptent encore l’avis de transaction directe avant de recevoir vos coordonnées.
korean: 모든 공개는 인증되고 기록됩니다. 구매자는 연락처를 받기 전에 직거래 안내에 동의해야 합니다.
chinese: 每次披露都会经过验证并记录。买家在获取您的联系方式前仍须接受直接交易声明。

english: Could not save your contact settings.
french: Impossible d’enregistrer vos paramètres de contact.

english: Signed-in buyers can request this WhatsApp number.
kinyarwanda: Abaguzi binjiye bashobora gusaba iyi nimero ya WhatsApp.
swahili: Wanunuzi walioingia wanaweza kuomba namba hii ya WhatsApp.
french: Les acheteurs connectés peuvent demander ce numéro WhatsApp.
korean: 로그인한 구매자가 이 WhatsApp 번호를 요청할 수 있습니다.
chinese: 已登录的买家可以请求此 WhatsApp 号码。

english: A critical safety check failed. Ask the seller about it before you decide.
kinyarwanda: Igenzura rikomeye ry’umutekano ntiryatsinzwe. Baza umugurisha iby’ibyo mbere yo gufata icyemezo.
swahili: Ukaguzi muhimu wa usalama haukufaulu. Muulize muuzaji kabla ya kuamua.
french: Un contrôle de sécurité critique a échoué. Interrogez le vendeur avant de décider.
korean: 중요한 안전 점검 항목이 불합격했습니다. 결정하기 전에 판매자에게 문의하세요.
chinese: 有一项关键安全检查未通过。请在决定前向卖家询问。

english: This car was inspected and is listed with the findings below. Agree the price with the seller knowing them.
kinyarwanda: Iyi modoka yarasuzumwe kandi irashyizwe ku rutonde hamwe n’ibyabonetse biri hasi. Muvuganire igiciro n’umugurisha muzi ibi.
swahili: Gari hii ilikaguliwa na imeorodheshwa pamoja na matokeo yaliyo hapa chini. Kubaliana bei na muuzaji ukiyajua.
french: Ce véhicule a été inspecté et publié avec les constats ci-dessous. Négociez le prix avec le vendeur en les connaissant.
korean: 이 차량은 검사를 거쳐 아래 결과와 함께 게시되었습니다. 내용을 확인하고 판매자와 가격을 협의하세요.
chinese: 这辆车已经过检测，并连同下列发现一并发布。请在了解这些情况后与卖家商定价格。

english: Did not pass the Sawa standard
french: N'a pas atteint la norme Sawa

english: No inspection report is published for this vehicle yet.
kinyarwanda: Nta raporo y’isuzuma irashyirwa hanze kuri iyi modoka.
swahili: Bado hakuna ripoti ya ukaguzi iliyochapishwa kwa gari hii.
french: Aucun rapport d'inspection n'est encore publié pour ce véhicule.
korean: 이 차량의 검사 보고서는 아직 게시되지 않았습니다.
chinese: 该车辆的检测报告尚未发布。

english: Could not load inspection centers. Try again.
kinyarwanda: Ntibyakunze gutangiza ibigo by’isuzuma. Ongera ugerageze.
swahili: Imeshindwa kupakia vituo vya ukaguzi. Jaribu tena.
french: Impossible de charger les centres d’inspection. Réessayez.
korean: 검사 센터를 불러오지 못했습니다. 다시 시도하세요.
chinese: 无法加载检测中心，请重试。

english: No inspection centers are currently accepting bookings.
kinyarwanda: Nta bigo by’isuzuma byemera ubwiyandikishe ubu.
swahili: Hakuna kituo cha ukaguzi kinachopokea miadi kwa sasa.
french: Aucun centre d’inspection n’accepte de réservation pour le moment.
korean: 현재 예약을 받는 검사 센터가 없습니다.
chinese: 目前没有接受预约的检测中心。

english: As listed by the provider. Agreed and paid directly with them; Sawa Cars does not hold it.
kinyarwanda: Nk’uko yatanzwe n’utanga serivisi. Mubyumvikanaho kandi mukayishyurana mwembi; Sawa Cars ntiyayibika.
swahili: Kama ilivyoorodheshwa na mtoa huduma. Mnakubaliana na kulipana moja kwa moja; Sawa Cars haishikilii.
french: Indiquée par le loueur. Convenue et réglée directement avec lui ; Sawa Cars ne la détient pas.
korean: 제공자가 게시한 금액입니다. 제공자와 직접 합의하고 지불하며 Sawa Cars는 보관하지 않습니다.
chinese: 以车主标注为准，由您与车主直接商定并支付，Sawa Cars 不代收。

english: Deposit and how it is returned

kinyarwanda: Ubufasha igihe imodoka yapfuye mu nzira

french: Toutes les annonces · depuis le début

english: Reply to inquiries quickly — buyers move on fast
kinyarwanda: Subiza ibibazo vuba — abaguzi bahita bakomeza ahandi
swahili: Jibu maswali haraka — wanunuzi huendelea haraka
french: Répondez vite aux demandes — les acheteurs passent vite à autre chose
korean: 문의에 빠르게 답하세요 — 구매자는 금방 다른 곳으로 갑니다
chinese: 尽快回复咨询——买家很快就会转向别处

english: Keep your price, photos and contact settings up to date
kinyarwanda: Gumana igiciro, amafoto n’amakuru yo kuvugana bigezweho
swahili: Weka bei, picha na mipangilio ya mawasiliano ikiwa ya kisasa
french: Gardez prix, photos et paramètres de contact à jour
korean: 가격, 사진, 연락처 설정을 최신으로 유지하세요
chinese: 保持价格、照片和联系设置为最新

english: Your inspection for {{title}} is confirmed. Bring your vehicle and service records.
kinyarwanda: Isuzuma rya {{title}} ryemejwe. Zana imodoka n’inyandiko z’isanwa ryayo.
swahili: Ukaguzi wa {{title}} umethibitishwa. Leta gari lako na kumbukumbu za huduma.
french: Votre inspection de {{title}} est confirmée. Apportez votre véhicule et vos carnets d’entretien.
korean: {{title}} 검사가 확정되었습니다. 차량과 정비 기록을 지참하세요.
chinese: {{title}} 的检测已确认，请携带车辆和保养记录。

english: We check it still meets every publication requirement first.
kinyarwanda: Tubanza kureba ko kigikurikiza ibisabwa byose mbere yo kugitangaza.
swahili: Tunakagua kwanza kama bado linakidhi masharti yote ya uchapishaji.
french: Nous vérifions d’abord qu’elle respecte toujours toutes les conditions de publication.
korean: 먼저 모든 게시 요건을 아직 충족하는지 확인합니다.
chinese: 我们会先核实它仍满足所有发布要求。

french: Votre annonce est de nouveau en ligne.

english: Buyers won’t see it until you make it live again.
kinyarwanda: Abaguzi ntibazaribona kugeza ubwo uzongera kurigaragaza.
french: Les acheteurs ne la verront plus tant que vous ne la remettez pas en ligne.
korean: 다시 게시하기 전까지 구매자에게 보이지 않습니다.
chinese: 在您重新上线之前，买家将看不到它。

english: Could not update the price. Try again.
french: Impossible de mettre à jour le prix. Réessayez.

english: That change could not be saved.
french: Cette modification n’a pas pu être enregistrée.

english: It leaves the marketplace for good — this can’t be undone.
kinyarwanda: Ive ku isoko burundu — ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
french: Elle quitte définitivement la place de marché — c’est irréversible.
korean: 마켓에서 영구히 내려가며 되돌릴 수 없습니다.
chinese: 将永久下架，此操作无法撤销。

english: Choose a reason so we know what to fix.
kinyarwanda: Hitamo impamvu kugira ngo tumenye icyo dukosora.
swahili: Chagua sababu ili tujue cha kurekebisha.
french: Choisissez une raison pour que nous sachions quoi améliorer.
korean: 무엇을 개선해야 할지 알 수 있도록 이유를 선택하세요.
chinese: 请选择一个原因，帮助我们改进。

english: Your listings come down, your number stops being shown, and you are signed out everywhere — straight away. Nothing is erased for {{days}} days: until then you can sign back in with the same password and pick up where you left off. After that it is permanent.
kinyarwanda: Amatangazo yawe arakurwaho, nimero yawe ntikigaragara, kandi uvanwa muri konti ahantu hose — ako kanya. Nta kintu gisibwa mu minsi {{days}}: kugeza icyo gihe ushobora kongera kwinjira ukoresheje ijambo ry’ibanga rimwe ugakomereza aho wari ugeze. Nyuma yaho birasibwa burundu.
swahili: Matangazo yako yanaondolewa, namba yako haionyeshwi tena, na unatolewa kila mahali — mara moja. Hakuna kinachofutwa kwa siku {{days}}: hadi wakati huo unaweza kuingia tena kwa nenosiri lile lile na kuendelea ulipoishia. Baada ya hapo ni kudumu.
french: Vos annonces sont retirées, votre numéro n’est plus affiché et vous êtes déconnecté partout — immédiatement. Rien n’est effacé pendant {{days}} jours : d’ici là, vous pouvez vous reconnecter avec le même mot de passe et tout retrouver. Ensuite, c’est définitif.
korean: 게시물이 내려가고, 번호가 더 이상 표시되지 않으며, 모든 기기에서 즉시 로그아웃됩니다. {{days}}일 동안은 아무것도 삭제되지 않으며, 그동안 같은 비밀번호로 다시 로그인해 이어서 사용할 수 있습니다. 그 이후에는 영구 삭제됩니다.
chinese: 您的车辆将下架，号码不再显示，所有设备将立即退出登录。{{days}} 天内不会删除任何数据：在此期间，您可以用原密码重新登录并继续使用。之后将永久删除。

english: You are signed out everywhere and any listings are off the marketplace. We have emailed you what happens next.
kinyarwanda: Wavuye muri konti ahantu hose kandi amatangazo yose yavuye ku isoko. Twaguhaye imeri isobanura ibikurikira.
swahili: Umetolewa kila mahali na matangazo yoyote yameondolewa sokoni. Tumekutumia barua pepe kuhusu hatua zinazofuata.
french: Vous êtes déconnecté partout et vos annonces sont retirées. Nous vous avons envoyé la suite par e-mail.
korean: 모든 기기에서 로그아웃되었고 게시물은 마켓에서 내려갔습니다. 다음 절차를 이메일로 보내 드렸습니다.
chinese: 您已在所有设备退出登录，所有车辆已下架。后续步骤已通过邮件发送给您。

english: You are signed out everywhere and any listings are off the marketplace.\n\nUntil {{date}} you can sign in with the same email and password to reopen it, and everything comes back. After that it is erased for good. We have emailed you the same details.
kinyarwanda: Wavuye muri konti ahantu hose kandi amatangazo yose yavuye ku isoko.\n\nKugeza ku wa {{date}} ushobora kongera kwinjira ukoresheje imeri n’ijambo ry’ibanga bimwe kugira ngo uyifungure, byose bigaruke. Nyuma yaho irasibwa burundu. Twaguhaye imeri irimo ayo makuru.
swahili: Umetolewa kila mahali na matangazo yoyote yameondolewa sokoni.\n\nHadi {{date}} unaweza kuingia kwa barua pepe na nenosiri lile lile kulifungua tena, na kila kitu kinarudi. Baada ya hapo kinafutwa kabisa. Tumekutumia maelezo haya kwa barua pepe.
french: Vous êtes déconnecté partout et vos annonces sont retirées.\n\nJusqu’au {{date}}, vous pouvez vous reconnecter avec le même e-mail et mot de passe pour rouvrir le compte et tout retrouver. Ensuite, il est effacé définitivement. Nous vous avons envoyé ces informations par e-mail.
korean: 모든 기기에서 로그아웃되었고 게시물은 마켓에서 내려갔습니다.\n\n{{date}}까지는 같은 이메일과 비밀번호로 로그인해 계정을 다시 열 수 있으며 모든 것이 복구됩니다. 그 이후에는 영구 삭제됩니다. 같은 내용을 이메일로 보내 드렸습니다.
chinese: 您已在所有设备退出登录，所有车辆已下架。\n\n在 {{date}} 之前，您可以用相同的邮箱和密码登录以重新开通账户，所有内容都会恢复。之后将被永久删除。我们已将相同的说明发送到您的邮箱。

english: The account cannot be deleted while required records are still active.
kinyarwanda: Konti ntishobora gusibwa mu gihe hari inyandiko z’ingenzi zikiri zikora.
swahili: Akaunti haiwezi kufutwa wakati rekodi muhimu bado zinatumika.
french: Le compte ne peut pas être supprimé tant que des enregistrements obligatoires sont actifs.
korean: 필수 기록이 아직 활성 상태여서 계정을 삭제할 수 없습니다.
chinese: 在必要记录仍然有效时，无法删除账户。

kinyarwanda: Andika ijambo ry’ibanga ryawe kugira ngo wemeze.
french: Saisissez votre mot de passe pour confirmer.

english: Email me when I get a new message
kinyarwanda: Nyoherereza imeri igihe mbonye ubutumwa bushya
swahili: Nitumie barua pepe ninapopokea ujumbe mpya
french: M’envoyer un e-mail quand je reçois un nouveau message
chinese: 收到新消息时通过邮箱通知我

english: Only when you have no session open anywhere — at most one email per conversation per hour, and it never includes what was said.
kinyarwanda: Gusa igihe nta gihe cy’ikoreshwa cyafunguye ahandi — nta rushya rurenze rumwe ku kiganiro mu isaha, kandi ntirwerekana icyavuzwe.
swahili: Tu wakati sina kipindi wazi popote — barua pepe moja kwa kila mazungumzo kwa saa, na haionyeshi kilichosemwa.
french: Uniquement si vous n’avez aucune session ouverte — un e-mail par conversation au maximum toutes les heures, et jamais le contenu du message.
korean: 어디에서도 접속 중이 아닐 때만 보내며, 대화당 최대 1시간에 한 번이고 메시지 내용은 포함되지 않습니다.
chinese: 仅在您未在任何地方保持登录状态时发送——每个对话每小时最多一封，且绝不包含消息内容。

english: Could not open the page. Please try again.
I didn’t find what I was looking for
french: Je n’ai pas trouvé ce que je cherchais

english: I don’t want my details on the platform
kinyarwanda: Sinshaka amakuru yanjye kuri uru rubuga
french: Je ne veux pas mes informations sur la plateforme
korean: 내 정보를 플랫폼에 두고 싶지 않아요
chinese: 我不想把我的信息放在平台上

french: Trop de messages ou de notifications

english: The notification could not be delivered. Please try again later.
kinyarwanda: Imenyesha ntiryashoboye kugezwa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
swahili: Arifa haikuweza kufikishwa. Jaribu tena baadaye.
french: La notification n’a pas pu être livrée. Réessayez plus tard.
korean: 알림을 전달하지 못했습니다. 나중에 다시 시도하세요.
chinese: 通知未能送达，请稍后再试。

english: This phone is not registered for notifications yet. Switch them on first.
kinyarwanda: Iyi telefoni ntiyiyandikisha ku menyesha. Banza ubifungure.
swahili: Simu hii bado haijasajiliwa kwa arifa. Ziwashe kwanza.
french: Ce téléphone n’est pas encore enregistré. Activez d’abord les notifications.
korean: 이 휴대폰은 아직 알림에 등록되지 않았습니다. 먼저 알림을 켜세요.
chinese: 此手机尚未注册通知，请先开启通知。

english: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
kinyarwanda: Igerageza ryoherejwe. Rigomba kugera mu masegonda make.
swahili: Jaribio limetumwa. Linapaswa kufika baada ya sekunde chache.
french: Test envoyé. Il devrait arriver dans quelques secondes.
korean: 테스트를 보냈습니다. 몇 초 안에 도착합니다.
chinese: 测试已发送，几秒钟内应能收到。

english: Please wait a few seconds before sending another test.
kinyarwanda: Tegereza amasegonda make mbere yo kohereza irindi.
swahili: Subiri sekunde chache kabla ya jaribio jingine.
french: Patientez quelques secondes avant un nouveau test.
korean: 다른 테스트를 보내기 전에 잠시 기다려 주세요.
chinese: 请稍等几秒再发送下一次测试。

english: You are on the latest version.
It is downloaded already. Restarting takes a second and you will not be signed out.
kinyarwanda: Yamaze gukururwa. Gutangira bifata akanya gato kandi ntuvanwa muri konti.
swahili: Imeshapakuliwa. Kuwasha upya kunachukua sekunde moja na hutatolewa kwenye akaunti.
french: Elle est déjà téléchargée. Le redémarrage prend une seconde et vous restez connecté.
korean: 이미 다운로드되었습니다. 재시작은 잠깐이면 되고 로그아웃되지 않습니다.
chinese: 已下载完成。重启只需一秒，不会退出登录。

english: Could not reach the update server. Try again on a better connection.
kinyarwanda: Ntibyakunze kugera kuri seriveri y’ivugurura. Ongera ugerageze ufite interineti ikomeye.
swahili: Imeshindwa kufikia seva ya masasisho. Jaribu tena ukiwa na mtandao bora.
french: Impossible de joindre le serveur de mise à jour. Réessayez avec une meilleure connexion.
korean: 업데이트 서버에 연결하지 못했습니다. 연결이 좋은 곳에서 다시 시도하세요.
chinese: 无法连接更新服务器，请在网络更好时重试。

english: Updates apply to the installed app, not this development build.
kinyarwanda: Ivugurura rikora kuri porogaramu yashyizweho, si kuri iyi verisiyo y’iterambere.
swahili: Masasisho yanatumika kwenye programu iliyosakinishwa, si toleo hili la ukuzaji.
french: Les mises à jour concernent l’app installée, pas cette version de développement.
korean: 업데이트는 설치된 앱에만 적용되며 개발 빌드에는 적용되지 않습니다.
chinese: 更新仅适用于已安装的应用，不适用于此开发版本。

english: Your car was submitted, but the reference photos did not upload.
kinyarwanda: Imodoka yawe yoherejwe, ariko amafoto yo kuyigereranya ntiyoherejwe.
swahili: Gari lako limewasilishwa, lakini picha za marejeo hazikupakiwa.
french: Votre voiture a été soumise, mais les photos de référence n’ont pas été envoyées.
korean: 차량은 제출되었지만 참고 사진은 업로드되지 않았습니다.
chinese: 您的车辆已提交，但参考照片未能上传。

english: Your trust score shows buyers how reliable you have been. It is built from identity verification, completed sales, how quickly you reply, and buyer feedback.
kinyarwanda: Amanota y’icyizere yereka abaguzi uko wizewe. Abarwa hashingiwe ku kwemezwa indangamuntu, ibyagurishijwe, uko usubiza vuba n’ibitekerezo by’abaguzi.
swahili: Alama yako ya uaminifu inaonyesha wanunuzi jinsi ulivyo wa kuaminika. Inatokana na uthibitisho wa utambulisho, mauzo yaliyokamilika, kasi ya kujibu na maoni ya wanunuzi.
french: Votre score de confiance montre aux acheteurs votre fiabilité. Il repose sur la vérification d’identité, les ventes conclues, votre rapidité de réponse et les retours des acheteurs.
korean: 신뢰 점수는 구매자에게 판매자의 신뢰도를 보여 줍니다. 신원 확인, 완료된 판매, 답변 속도, 구매자 후기를 바탕으로 산정됩니다.
chinese: 信任得分向买家展示您的可靠程度，由身份验证、已完成销售、回复速度和买家反馈构成。

english: It moves out of your open requests. Any agreement you made with the renter is unaffected.
kinyarwanda: Kive mu byifuzo bifunguye. Ibyo mwumvikanyeho n’ubishaka ntibihinduka.
swahili: Litaondoka kwenye maombi yaliyo wazi. Makubaliano yoyote na mkodishaji hayaathiriki.
french: Elle quitte vos demandes ouvertes. Tout accord conclu avec le locataire reste valable.
korean: 열린 문의에서 사라집니다. 문의자와 맺은 합의에는 영향이 없습니다.
chinese: 它将从待处理询价中移除，您与对方已达成的约定不受影响。

english: When someone asks about one of your vehicles, it appears here and you get a notification.
kinyarwanda: Umuntu ubajije ku modoka yawe, bigaragara hano kandi ubona imenyesha.
swahili: Mtu akiuliza kuhusu gari lako, ombi linaonekana hapa na unapata arifa.
french: Quand quelqu’un se renseigne sur un de vos véhicules, la demande apparaît ici et vous êtes notifié.
korean: 누군가 차량에 문의하면 여기에 표시되고 알림을 받습니다.
chinese: 有人咨询您的车辆时，会显示在这里并通知您。

english: You have no rental vehicles on Sawa Cars yet.
kinyarwanda: Nta modoka zo gukodesha ufite kuri Sawa Cars.
swahili: Huna magari ya kukodisha kwenye Sawa Cars bado.
french: Vous n’avez pas encore de véhicule de location sur Sawa Cars.
korean: Sawa Cars에 등록된 렌트 차량이 아직 없습니다.
chinese: 您在 Sawa Cars 上还没有租赁车辆。

english: People who asked about your vehicles. Reply to them directly to agree dates, price and terms. Sawa Cars does not take part in the rental.
kinyarwanda: Abantu babajije ku modoka zawe. Mubasubize mu buryo butaziguye muvugane amatariki, igiciro n’amabwiriza. Sawa Cars ntiyinjira mu bukode.
swahili: Watu walioulizia magari yako. Wajibu moja kwa moja ili kukubaliana tarehe, bei na masharti. Sawa Cars haihusiki na ukodishaji.
french: Les personnes qui se renseignent sur vos véhicules. Répondez-leur directement pour convenir des dates, du prix et des conditions. Sawa Cars ne participe pas à la location.
korean: 차량에 관심을 보인 사람들입니다. 날짜, 가격, 조건은 직접 연락해 협의하세요. Sawa Cars는 대여에 관여하지 않습니다.
chinese: 咨询您车辆的用户。请直接联系对方商定日期、价格和条款。Sawa Cars 不参与租赁。

english: Could not load your requests. Check your connection and try again.
kinyarwanda: Ntibyakunze gutangiza ibyifuzo byawe. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
swahili: Imeshindwa kupakia maombi yako. Angalia mtandao na ujaribu tena.
french: Impossible de charger vos demandes. Vérifiez votre connexion.
korean: 문의를 불러오지 못했습니다. 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요.
chinese: 无法加载询价，请检查网络后重试。

english: Could not update the request. Please try again.
french: Impossible de mettre à jour la demande. Réessayez.

english: The provider confirms availability. This request does not reserve the vehicle.
kinyarwanda: Utanga serivisi ni we wemeza uboneka. Iki cyifuzo ntikibikira imodoka.
swahili: Mtoa huduma anathibitisha upatikanaji. Ombi hili halihifadhi gari.
french: Le loueur confirme la disponibilité. Cette demande ne réserve pas le véhicule.
korean: 제공자가 가능 여부를 확인합니다. 이 문의는 차량을 예약하지 않습니다.
chinese: 由车主确认可用性。此询价不会预留车辆。

english: Read and accept the direct-provider notice to continue.
kinyarwanda: Soma kandi wemere itangazo ry’utanga serivisi butaziguye kugira ngo ukomeze.
swahili: Soma na ukubali taarifa ya mtoa huduma wa moja kwa moja ili kuendelea.
french: Lisez et acceptez l’avis de transaction directe pour continuer.
chinese: 请阅读并接受直接交易声明后继续。

english: Enter a future date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
kinyarwanda: Andika itariki izaza mu buryo bwa YYYY-MM-DD.
swahili: Weka tarehe ya baadaye kwa muundo wa YYYY-MM-DD.
french: Saisissez une date future au format AAAA-MM-JJ.
chinese: 请按 YYYY-MM-DD 格式输入未来的日期。

english: The inquiry could not be sent. Please try again.
french: La demande n’a pas pu être envoyée. Réessayez.

kinyarwanda: Bwira utanga serivisi ikintu cyose cy’ingenzi
swahili: Mweleze mtoa huduma jambo lolote muhimu
french: Dites au loueur ce qui est important
korean: 제공자에게 전할 중요한 내용을 적어 주세요
chinese: 告诉车主任何重要信息

english: This is an inquiry, not a confirmed booking. The independent rental provider—not Sawa Cars—sets and manages the contract, payment, deposit, insurance, pickup, return and any dispute.
kinyarwanda: Iki ni icyifuzo, si ukubika byemejwe. Utanga ubukode wigenga — si Sawa Cars — ni we ugena kandi agacunga amasezerano, ubwishyu, ingwate, ubwishingizi, gufata no kugarura imodoka n’impaka zose.
swahili: Hili ni ombi, si uhifadhi uliothibitishwa. Mtoa huduma huru — si Sawa Cars — ndiye huweka na kusimamia mkataba, malipo, dhamana, bima, kuchukua, kurudisha na mgogoro wowote.
french: Ceci est une demande, pas une réservation confirmée. Le loueur indépendant — et non Sawa Cars — fixe et gère le contrat, le paiement, la caution, l’assurance, le retrait, la restitution et tout litige.
korean: 이는 문의일 뿐 확정된 예약이 아닙니다. 계약, 결제, 보증금, 보험, 인수·반납 및 분쟁은 독립 렌트 제공자가 정하고 관리하며 Sawa Cars는 관여하지 않습니다.
chinese: 这只是询价，并非确认预订。合同、付款、押金、保险、取还车及任何争议均由独立的租赁提供方（而非 Sawa Cars）设定和处理。

swahili: mfano: Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kigali

english: Reference {{ref}}. The provider will confirm availability, price, deposit, contract, pickup and return terms directly.
kinyarwanda: Nomero {{ref}}. Utanga serivisi azemeza uboneka, igiciro, ingwate, amasezerano, gufata no kugarura imodoka mu buryo butaziguye.
swahili: Rejea {{ref}}. Mtoa huduma atathibitisha moja kwa moja upatikanaji, bei, dhamana, mkataba, kuchukua na kurudisha.
french: Référence {{ref}}. Le loueur confirmera directement disponibilité, prix, caution, contrat, retrait et restitution.
korean: 참조번호 {{ref}}. 제공자가 이용 가능 여부, 가격, 보증금, 계약, 인수 및 반납 조건을 직접 확인해 드립니다.
chinese: 参考编号 {{ref}}。车主将直接向您确认可用性、价格、押金、合同、取车和还车条款。

kinyarwanda: Icyifuzo cyo kumenya niba iboneka cyoherejwe

english: This closes the availability request. It does not cancel any separate agreement you may already have made with the provider.
kinyarwanda: Ibi bifunga icyifuzo. Ntibihagarika andi masezerano mwaba mwarumvikanye n’utanga serivisi.
swahili: Hii inafunga ombi la upatikanaji. Haighairi makubaliano mengine yoyote uliyokwisha kufanya na mtoa huduma.
french: Cela clôt la demande de disponibilité. Cela n’annule aucun accord distinct déjà conclu avec le loueur.
korean: 가용성 문의만 종료되며, 제공자와 이미 맺은 별도의 합의는 취소되지 않습니다.
chinese: 这将关闭可用性询价，但不会取消您与车主已达成的任何单独约定。

english: Browse verified provider vehicles and request the dates you need.
kinyarwanda: Reba imodoka z’abatanga serivisi bemejwe usabe amatariki ukeneye.
swahili: Vinjari magari ya watoa huduma waliothibitishwa na uombe tarehe unazohitaji.
french: Parcourez les véhicules de loueurs vérifiés et demandez vos dates.
korean: 인증된 제공자의 차량을 둘러보고 원하는 날짜를 문의하세요.
chinese: 浏览已验证车主的车辆并询问您需要的日期。

english: These are availability requests—not bookings. The provider confirms dates and manages any contract, payment, deposit, pickup and return directly with you.
kinyarwanda: Ibi ni ibyifuzo byo kumenya uboneka — si ukubika. Utanga serivisi yemeza amatariki kandi agacunga amasezerano, ubwishyu, ingwate, gufata no kugarura imodoka mu buryo butaziguye nawe.
swahili: Haya ni maombi ya upatikanaji — si uhifadhi. Mtoa huduma anathibitisha tarehe na kusimamia mkataba, malipo, dhamana, kuchukua na kurudisha moja kwa moja nawe.
french: Ce sont des demandes de disponibilité, pas des réservations. Le loueur confirme les dates et gère directement avec vous contrat, paiement, caution, retrait et restitution.
korean: 예약이 아닌 이용 가능 여부 문의입니다. 날짜 확인과 계약, 결제, 보증금, 인수·반납은 제공자가 직접 진행합니다.
chinese: 这些是可用性询价，并非预订。日期确认以及合同、付款、押金、取还车均由车主直接与您处理。

swahili: Kitambulisho cha taifa kimethibitishwa na Sawa Cars
french: Pièce d’identité confirmée par Sawa Cars

english: No reviews yet — verified platform feedback will appear here.
kinyarwanda: Nta bitekerezo biraboneka — ibitekerezo byemejwe bizagaragara hano.
swahili: Bado hakuna tathmini — maoni yaliyothibitishwa yataonekana hapa.
french: Pas encore d’avis — les retours vérifiés apparaîtront ici.
korean: 아직 리뷰가 없습니다. 확인된 후기가 여기에 표시됩니다.
chinese: 暂无评价，经过验证的反馈将显示在这里。

english: We couldn’t load this seller’s profile. Check your connection and try again.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye gutangiza umwirondoro w’uyu mugurisha. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
swahili: Hatukuweza kupakia wasifu wa muuzaji huyu. Angalia mtandao na ujaribu tena.
french: Impossible de charger le profil de ce vendeur. Vérifiez votre connexion.
korean: 이 판매자의 프로필을 불러오지 못했습니다. 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요.
chinese: 无法加载该卖家的资料，请检查网络后重试。

english: The report didn’t send. Check your connection and try again.
kinyarwanda: Raporo ntiyoherejwe. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
swahili: Ripoti haikutumwa. Angalia mtandao na ujaribu tena.
french: Le signalement n’a pas été envoyé. Vérifiez votre connexion.
korean: 신고를 보내지 못했습니다. 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요.
chinese: 举报未发送成功，请检查网络后重试。

english: Our team reviews every report. The author is not told.
kinyarwanda: Itsinda ryacu risuzuma buri raporo. Uwabyanditse ntabimenyeshwa.
swahili: Timu yetu hupitia kila ripoti. Mwandishi hajulishwi.
french: Notre équipe examine chaque signalement. L’auteur n’est pas prévenu.
korean: 모든 신고는 팀이 검토합니다. 작성자에게는 알리지 않습니다.
chinese: 我们的团队会审核每一份举报，作者不会收到通知。

english: Thanks — our team will take a look.
french: Merci — notre équipe va examiner cela.
chinese: 谢谢，我们的团队会查看。

english: These are fees for Sawa Cars’ own inspection and listing services, paid or recorded at our office — never a marketplace transaction fee. Sawa Cars is not a party to any sale or rental; buyers, sellers and renters agree their own price, payment and terms directly.
kinyarwanda: Aya ni amafaranga ya serivisi za Sawa Cars ubwazo z’isuzuma n’ikodeshwa, yishyurwa cyangwa yanditswe ku kigo cyacu — ntabwo ari amafaranga y’ubucuruzi bwo ku isoko. Sawa Cars ntabwo ari uruhande mu igurisha cyangwa ikodeshwa; abaguzi, abagurisha n’abakodesha bumvikana bwite ku giciro, kwishyura n’amabwiriza.
swahili: Haya ni malipo kwa huduma za Sawa Cars mwenyewe za ukaguzi na tangazo, yanayolipwa au kuandikwa kituoni kwetu — si ada ya muamala wa sokoni. Sawa Cars si upande katika mauzo au ukodishaji wowote; wanunuzi, wauzaji na wakodishaji hukubaliana wenyewe bei, malipo na masharti.
french: Ce sont des frais pour les propres services d’inspection et d’annonce de Sawa Cars, payés ou enregistrés à notre bureau — jamais des frais de transaction sur le marché. Sawa Cars n’est partie à aucune vente ni location ; acheteurs, vendeurs et locataires conviennent eux-mêmes du prix, du paiement et des conditions.
korean: 이는 Sawa Cars 자체의 검사 및 등록 서비스에 대한 요금으로, 저희 사무실에서 지불되거나 기록됩니다 — 마켓플레이스 거래 수수료가 아닙니다. Sawa Cars는 어떤 판매나 렌트 계약의 당사자도 아니며, 구매자·판매자·렌트 이용자가 가격, 결제, 조건을 직접 합의합니다.
chinese: 这些费用是 Sawa Cars 自身检测及信息服务的收费，均在我们办公室支付或记录——绝非市场交易手续费。Sawa Cars 不是任何买卖或租赁交易的一方；买家、卖家及租车者直接自行约定价格、付款方式及条款。

english: Browsing, buying, selling and contacting a verified seller are free. These are the paid services: an independent inspection, a copy of an existing report, and keeping a rental car visible.
kinyarwanda: Gushakisha, kugura, kugurisha no kuvugana n’umugurisha wemejwe ni ubuntu. Ibi ni serivisi zishyurwa: isuzuma ryigenga, kopi ya raporo isanzweho, no gukomeza kwerekana imodoka ikodeshwa.
swahili: Kutafuta, kununua, kuuza na kuwasiliana na muuzaji aliyethibitishwa ni bure. Hizi ni huduma zinazolipiwa: ukaguzi huru, nakala ya ripoti iliyopo, na kuendelea kuonyesha gari la kukodisha.
french: Parcourir, acheter, vendre et contacter un vendeur vérifié est gratuit. Voici les services payants : une inspection indépendante, une copie d’un rapport existant, et le maintien de la visibilité d’une voiture de location.
korean: 둘러보기, 구매, 판매, 인증된 판매자에게 연락하는 것은 무료입니다. 아래는 유료 서비스입니다: 독립적인 검사, 기존 보고서 사본, 렌트 차량의 노출 유지.
chinese: 浏览、购买、出售及联系已认证卖家均免费。以下是付费服务：独立检测、获取已有报告的副本，以及保持租车信息可见。

english: Bring any car — one you are about to buy from someone else, not just a Sawa listing — to a center for the full 150-point inspection. Paid at the office; the report is yours either way.
kinyarwanda: Zana imodoka iyo ari yo yose — harimo n’iyo ugiye kugura ku wundi muntu, atari gusa iri ku rutonde rwa Sawa — ku kigo kugira ngo isuzumwe ku ngingo 150. Byishyurwa ku kigo; raporo iraguhabwa uko byagenda kose.
swahili: Leta gari lolote — ikiwa ni pamoja na lile unalokaribia kununua kutoka kwa mtu mwingine, si tu tangazo la Sawa — kituoni kwa ajili ya ukaguzi kamili wa pointi 150. Inalipwa kituoni; ripoti ni yako kwa hali yoyote.
french: Amenez n’importe quel véhicule — y compris un que vous êtes sur le point d’acheter à un particulier, pas seulement une annonce Sawa — dans un centre pour l’inspection complète en 150 points. Payée sur place ; le rapport vous revient dans tous les cas.

kinyarwanda: 50% ukoresheje banki, ukoresha nimero y’itumiza ryawe. Wohereza inyemezabwishyu; itsinda ryacu rirayigenzura.
swahili: 50% kwa uhamisho wa benki, ukitaja kumbukumbu ya oda. Unapakia uthibitisho; timu yetu inaukagua.
french: 50 % par virement, avec la référence de votre commande. Vous téléversez la preuve ; notre équipe la vérifie.
korean: 주문 번호를 기재해 은행 송금으로 50%. 증빙을 올리면 팀이 확인합니다.
chinese: 通过银行转账支付50%，注明订单编号。上传凭证后由我们的团队核对。

english: Customs clearance in Kigali, then the car is ready for you to collect.
kinyarwanda: Gasutamo i Kigali, hanyuma imodoka ikaba yiteguye ko uyifata.
swahili: Forodha Kigali, kisha gari liko tayari kuchukuliwa.
french: Dédouanement à Kigali, puis la voiture est prête à être récupérée.
korean: 키갈리 통관 후 차량 인수 준비 완료.
chinese: 在基加利清关后，车辆即可提取。

english: When it arrives, the car is inspected in Kigali before you pay anything more.
kinyarwanda: Iyo igeze, imodoka isuzumirwa i Kigali mbere y’uko wishyura ikindi.
swahili: Likifika, gari hukaguliwa Kigali kabla hujalipa zaidi.
french: À l’arrivée, la voiture est inspectée à Kigali avant tout autre paiement.
korean: 도착 후 추가 결제 전에 키갈리에서 검사합니다.
chinese: 车辆到达后，在您支付其余款项前先在基加利检测。

english: One figure for the car landed in Kigali, with what it includes written out.
kinyarwanda: Igiciro kimwe cy’imodoka igeze i Kigali, n’ibyo kirimo byanditse.
swahili: Kiasi kimoja kwa gari likifika Kigali, na kinachojumuishwa kimeandikwa.
french: Un montant pour la voiture rendue à Kigali, avec son contenu détaillé.
korean: 키갈리 도착 기준 단일 금액과 포함 내역.
chinese: 运抵基加利的一个总价，并列明所含项目。

english: The model, origin and year you want, and anything we should know.
kinyarwanda: Moderi, aho ituruka n’umwaka ushaka, n’ibindi dukwiye kumenya.
swahili: Modeli, asili na mwaka unaotaka, na chochote tunachopaswa kujua.
french: Le modèle, l’origine et l’année voulus, et tout ce que nous devons savoir.
korean: 원하는 모델, 원산지, 연식과 참고 사항.
chinese: 您想要的车型、产地和年份，以及其他需要我们了解的信息。

english: The car is bought, booked on a ship and tracked in transit to Kigali.
kinyarwanda: Imodoka iragurwa, igashyirwa ku bwato, igakurikiranwa kugeza i Kigali.
swahili: Gari linanunuliwa, linawekwa kwenye meli na kufuatiliwa hadi Kigali.
french: La voiture est achetée, réservée sur un navire et suivie jusqu’à Kigali.
korean: 차량 구매, 선적 예약, 키갈리까지 운송 추적.
chinese: 车辆完成采购、订舱，并跟踪运输至基加利。

swahili: Jinsi oda ya kuagiza inavyofanya kazi
french: Comment se déroule une commande d’import

english: Studio image of the current model. Colour, trim and your exact unit are confirmed on the quotation.
kinyarwanda: Ifoto y’imodoka ya vuba. Ibara, urwego n’imodoka yawe nyirizina bizemezwa mu giciro uhabwa.
swahili: Picha ya studio ya modeli ya sasa. Rangi, toleo na gari lako halisi hubainishwa kwenye bei utakayopewa.
french: Image studio du modèle actuel. La couleur, la finition et votre véhicule exact sont confirmés dans le devis.
korean: 현행 모델의 스튜디오 이미지입니다. 색상, 트림, 실제 차량은 견적서에서 확정됩니다.
chinese: 此为当前车型的棚拍图。颜色、配置及您的具体车辆以报价单为准。

swahili: Ombi la kuagiza limetumwa kwa mafanikio!
